# Old Wisdom // Retold
A non-fiction book series for teens 12-16 that rebuilds classic wisdom - Sun Tzu, Dale Carnegie, the Stoics - into game-style playbooks: Cheat Codes, Smart Moves, and traps to avoid. Author: Eric Han, Auckland NZ. No dating content, no swearing, 5-8 minute chapters built for reluctant readers.

## Books
- Book 1: The Social Playbook - friendship, fake friends, group-chat drama, influence (Carnegie, Socrates). https://a.co/d/0gjqlkB6
- Book 2: The War Playbook - bullies, rivalries, pile-ons, composure under pressure (Sun Tzu's Art of War, zero violence glorification). https://a.co/d/0gu0a2CR
- Book 3: The Discipline Playbook - coming (the Stoics)

## Pages
- https://oldwisdomretold.com/: series overview, FAQ for parents, free Chapter 1
- https://oldwisdomretold.com/quiz.html: free 12-question social skills diagnostic (teen and parent versions)
